title: Words of Wisdom: Representational Harms in Learning From AI Communication
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure anything related to faith or religion. Its focus is on measuring how human evaluators perceive representational harms and index identity (specifically race, gender, and age) in AI-generated language.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion. The study's scope is limited to representational harms concerning race, gender, and age.
